text: In 2009, RBS launched the IMBA program which dedicates to provide an international study environment and foster world-class management elites with an international vision. The IMBA students from overseas and China will take classes together. All the core courses will be taught in English and certain elective courses taught in English or bilingually. Teaching materials are chosen from popular textbooks and cases used in American and European business schools and are combined with the practice of Chinese business techniques. Lessons are given by professors with rich experiences both fro RBS and famous overseas business schools. RBS has established long-term partnerships with many business schools worldwide. We offer students exchange programs as part of our curriculum. Students can choose to spend a semester or a year studying abroad at one of the 20 and more partner schools. The exchange program aims to provide students with an opportunity to broaden their outlook, extend their network of multicultural friends and better understand enterprise operations in foreign countries. More joint international programs, such as ExMP which is collaborated between RBS and Torino Wireless Foundation of Italy, are being carried out. We also have good relationships with many large multinational corporations and local enterprises. IMBA students are privileged in their internships and jobs. The school provides high-quality MBA courses, rich extracurricular activities, various international programs and comprehensive career development services. During the development of our MBA education, RBS has formed the unique feature of emphasizing spiritual reconstruction, action orientation, international vision and learning through self-construction. The IMBA program is a two-year full time study. Students who meet the graduation requirements will be awarded with the MBA degree by RUC. Courses Compulsory Courses Managerial Economics Data Model and Decisions Accounting Financial Management Enterprise Strategic Management Management Information System Operations Management Marketing Management Organizational Behavior Leadership Business report (Case Analysis) Writing Managerial Communication Business Ethnics Elective Courses in Six Areas Marketing Enterprise Strategy and Culture Human Resource Finance and Portfolio International Management Real Estate Investment and Management Enroll Plan The IMBA program starts in September each year. We are interested in candidates with diversified education backgrounds, experiences and cultures. All items in the application form will be seriously evaluated thus we highly recommend you carefully fill out the application form. The deadline for Fall 2011 matriculation will be May 31st 2011. We hope to have applicants with the following characteristics: — Self-motivation, leadership potentiality — Analytical and innovative ability — Maturity and social responsibility — Excellent career potential
